snippet.title: Curse of the Crimson Stag | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Curse of the Crimson Tag on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4669670/Curse_of_the_Crimson_Stag/

Step into the mystery of Whiteroot Hotel in Curse of the Crimson Stag, a story-driven thriller blending folk horror, investigation, and supernatural suspense by 
ONE-O-ONE GAMES and Daedalic Entertainment.

Join Brit as she explores the abandoned hotel for a documentary project, uncovering the dark secrets behind a series of tragic deaths and the legend of the Crimson Stag, a wrathful spirit said to haunt the surrounding woods.

🦌 Explore haunting locations
🔎 Solve puzzles and investigate mysteries
🌲 Dive into a gripping folk-horror narrative

Will you uncover the truth… or become part of the curse?
